subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality.”?
options: Students could write down something kind they saw at school.
Then students saw that it could support fairness.
The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.
It also changed how students saw second-hand things.
